write_up: You’re aiming for IT support after a help desk internship at Chattahoochee County Schools and customer-facing work at Peachtree Electronics. It’s common for an early-career resume to list tasks without showing how much work came through. Here, that makes it difficult to distinguish your support experience in a pile.

The Active Directory line is your best model: it names both the account work and the tool. Your education currently comes before your work history, and the resume doesn’t account for time after May 2025.

Let’s start with the internship. Add the ticket volume and laptop setup details you can confirm, then account for the time since it ended. Your A.A.S. and CompTIA A+ can stay prominent while Experience moves above Education.
